definitions.gloss: full name, family name and given name
definitions.explanation: A person's complete name consisting of both surname and given name. Used in formal and official contexts.

examples.japanese: {氏名|しめい}をフルネームで{記入|きにゅう}してください。
{応募者|おうぼしゃ}の{氏名|しめい}と{住所|じゅうしょ}を{確認|かくにん}した。
examples.english: I confirmed the applicant's name and address.

examples.japanese: {氏名|しめい}{不詳|ふしょう}の{男性|だんせい}が{病院|びょういん}に{運|はこ}ばれた。
examples.english: An unidentified man was brought to the hospital.
examples.notes: 氏名不詳 = name unknown, unidentified

notes:
USAGE: {氏名|しめい} is a formal term used on official forms, documents, and in administrative contexts. In everyday conversation, {名前|なまえ} is more natural.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {氏名|しめい}を{記入|きにゅう}する (to fill in one's name)
- {氏名|しめい}{不詳|ふしょう} (name unknown)
- {本人|ほんにん}{氏名|しめい} (name of the person in question)

HOMOPHONE NOTE: Be careful not to confuse with:
- {使命|しめい} (mission, vocation)
- {指名|しめい} (nomination, designation)
